Legitimised default guarantees but capped skin-in-the-game. Fintech-bank co-lending restructured around the cap; some balance-sheet-light models became unviable.
+25pp risk weights on unsecured PL & bank→NBFC lending
The cycle-turner: fintech PL growth halved within two quarters (see chart above); NBFC borrowing costs rose 30–50 bps; unsecured mix shrank across lenders.
Largest fintech enforcement ever. Sector learnt the partner-bank migration playbook; compliance became a valuation input, not a cost line.
LTV and valuation discipline imposed sector-wide; compliance premium now priced into gold NBFCs.
AU applied; defines the endgame for scaled SFBs and resets the licence-arbitrage math for PE buyers.

One master direction: LSP disclosure, DLG reporting, borrower protection, cooling-off rights. The compliance moat around scaled digital lenders got deeper.
Rate cycle turned decisively. NBFC margin tailwind through FY26; growth capital got cheaper exactly as risk weights eased.
